official.deadline_note: No closing date is published. Adelaide states applications open from Monday 24 August 2026 and are reviewed on a rolling basis, with scholarship offers made throughout the recruitment cycle until all allocations have been exhausted.
official.application_cycle: Rolling recruitment-cycle intake; applications open from Monday 24 August 2026
official.status_note: Adelaide's page states applications open from Monday 24 August 2026 and that scholarships are limited, with offers made throughout the recruitment cycle until all allocations have been exhausted.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The Adelaide Academic Excellence Scholarship offers a 50% tuition fee reduction and is a prestigious, highly competitive award with limited places for students with a high distinction average.
official.funding_period: for the standard full-time duration of the degree
benefits: Applied to the Offer of Admission for the standard full-time duration of the eligible degree.
Recipients are notified prior to commencement at Adelaide University.
Free academic support from the Student Academic Learning Support team.
eligibility: Be applying to a CRICOS registered bachelor degree (minimum 96 units / 2 years equivalent) after the application of any credit/RPL, or a CRICOS registered master degree (minimum 72 units / 1.5 years equivalent) after the application of any credit/RPL, at Adelaide University.
Undergraduate only: minimum ATAR of 99 (or international equivalent) in the qualification used as the basis of admission.
Undergraduate and postgraduate: minimum overall Grade Point Average (GPA) of 6.7 on a 7.0 scale, or a comparable score, in the qualification used as the basis of admission.
Not be applying to study one of the Excluded Programs.
Not be an Australia Awards recipient, and not be an International Sponsored Student entitled to a tuition fee waiver equal to or greater than the scholarship value.
requirements: Maintain a minimum Program Term GPA of 5.5 on a 7.0 scale in academic progress carried out each compulsory Study Period.

The scholarship may be suspended if the recipient's GPA falls below the minimum; if the overall GPA falls below the minimum the scholarship is not applied to the next invoice, and it recommences on the following invoice once the GPA returns to 5.5 or above.
A student cannot receive both a scholarship and a sponsor tuition fee waiver concurrently.
Submit the appropriate scholarship application form together with the degree application.
documents: Completed Adelaide Academic Excellence Scholarship Application Form, or the dedicated SATAC version for SATAC applicants.
Completed degree application submitted together with the scholarship form.
Undergraduate applicants: evidence of an ATAR of 99 or international equivalent, or of an overall GPA of 6.7 on a 7.0 scale in the qualification used as the basis of admission.
selection_criteria: Your application will be assessed by a selection panel and based on merit.
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis with scholarship offers made throughout the recruitment cycle, until all allocations have been exhausted.
Academic thresholds: ATAR 99 or international equivalent (undergraduate) or overall GPA 6.7 on a 7.0 scale or comparable score (undergraduate and postgraduate).
Excluded Programs, Australia Awards recipients, and sponsored students entitled to an equal or greater waiver are excluded.
coverage: Applied for the standard full-time duration of the recipient's undergraduate or postgraduate Coursework Program.
application_method: Complete the appropriate Adelaide Academic Excellence Scholarship Application Form (standard or SATAC version).
Submit the completed form together with the degree application, through an Adelaide University Education Agent or directly via the Online Application System.
Applications open from Monday 24 August 2026; scholarships are limited.
official.application_route: Complete the Adelaide Academic Excellence Scholarship Application Form (or the SATAC version) and submit it with your degree application through an Adelaide University Education Agent or the Online Application System.
official.citizenship_residency: International students only (the page lists Residency as International Student). Australia Awards recipients and International Sponsored Students entitled to a waiver equal to or greater than the scholarship value are excluded.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Excluded Programs are not eligible; the published list covers named medicine, dentistry, veterinary, health science and MBA programs at both undergraduate and postgraduate level.
official.duration: Standard full-time duration of the recipient's undergraduate or postgraduate Coursework Program
official.description: The Adelaide Academic Excellence Scholarship (50%) is a prestigious, highly competitive award with limited places for students with a high distinction average. It recognises international students commencing undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degrees who have achieved outstanding academic performance in their previous studies.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a 50% tuition reduction, not a full scholarship, so you still need to fund roughly half your fees plus all living costs yourself. Because it is allocated on a rolling basis until places run out, applying as soon as the form opens on 24 August 2026 matters more than polishing your application for weeks - late applicants compete for whatever is left of the allocation. Undergraduate entry needs an ATAR of 99 or international equivalent, while both undergraduate and postgraduate entry need an overall GPA of 6.7 on a 7.0 scale, which makes this an award for genuinely top-of-cohort results rather than strong-average students. Check the Excluded Programs list before you build your application around it: a large number of Adelaide's health, medicine, veterinary, psychology and MBA programs are named and are simply not eligible.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Near-top-of-cohort international school leavers and postgraduates with an ATAR 99+ or a 6.7/7.0 GPA who are targeting an eligible Adelaide coursework degree outside the Excluded Programs list.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your intended degree is not on the published Excluded Programs list before doing anything else
Work out whether your basis of admission is the ATAR route (undergraduate only) or the GPA route, and gather the transcript evidence for that route
Check your credit/RPL position, because the bachelor degree must be at least 96 units and the master at least 72 units after credit is applied
Download the correct application form - the standard one, or the SATAC version if you are applying through SATAC
Lodge the scholarship form and the degree application together, not one after the other
Note the 5.5/7.0 maintenance GPA now and plan your first-year study load around keeping it
common_rejection_risks: Applying for a degree on the Excluded Programs list, which disqualifies the application outright
Missing the ATAR 99 or GPA 6.7 threshold in the qualification actually used as the basis of admission
Submitting the scholarship form separately from, or after, the degree application
Being a sponsored student whose existing tuition waiver already equals or exceeds 50%, which makes you ineligible
Leaving the application late in the cycle and finding the allocation exhausted
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The other 50% of tuition fees, plus all living costs, accommodation, Overseas Student Health Cover, flights and visa costs, none of which this scholarship touches.
document_audit: There are two different application forms - the standard one and a separate SATAC version - so confirm which applies to your application route before you start filling one in
The scholarship form and the degree application must be submitted together; a stand-alone scholarship form does not work
Undergraduate academic thresholds must be evidenced in the qualification used as the basis of admission, not in any earlier qualification
Credit and RPL change the effective length of your degree, which is what the 96-unit and 72-unit minima are measured against
alerts: Places are limited and allocated on merit on a rolling basis, so there is no deadline to wait for and no advantage to applying late
The scholarship can be suspended, and stops being applied to invoices, if your Program Term GPA drops below 5.5/7.0 in a compulsory Study Period
You cannot hold this scholarship and a sponsor tuition fee waiver at the same time
Australia Awards recipients are excluded from this scholarship entirely
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Download the correct application form, complete it alongside your degree application, and submit both together through an Adelaide Education Agent or the Online Application System once applications open on 24 August 2026.
